summary: Rainmaker Worldwide filed an 8-K reporting two interim services agreements effective September 22, 2026. It engaged 2752128 Ontario Ltd., through director/Treasurer Kelly White, as Interim VP Finance Administration for US$2,500 monthly, totaling US$8,250 through December 31, 2026, replacing a prior interim agreement. Separately, Miranda Water Technologies, an Ontario affiliate, provides strategic management services via President/CEO Michael A. Skinner and Ryan D. Moore, also through December 31, 2026. Disinterested directors approved; White abstained. Compensation may be deferred absent sufficient cash, highlighting liquidity strain. Watch for further related-party arrangements, going-concern risk and possible delisting or financing events.
